liveCapabilityEvidence.finding: DealInitialHands draws with InitialDeal; inspection found no general-purpose persistent per-physical-card initial-hand tag for Huaiyuan.
Existing RecastProgramSelectedCards is an owner's activation-selected one-hand-card recast; not a full two-player independently chosen Chongxin recast.
DaoshuGuessState proves a frame-owned private guess mechanism is available, but resolves immediate take/give-back; it does not implement a future exact-Play-phase secret prediction.
Round tracking is capability-dependent; a round-escalating Xiongshu family needs its own dependency declaration.
Native PlayEnding and PlayPhaseStarting windows exist; a delayed prediction must bind the exact actual phase rather than whole-turn history.
ProgramBasicCardName unifies elemental Slash kinds to Slash, reusable for real effective use-name matching.
DamageAppliedEvent carries actual source/target/amount and source-less metadata; ordinary HP loss must not create Jianhui damager memory.
RevealGeneralCommand exists for existing hidden-general systems; this does not establish complete ordinary-identity concealment/entry semantics for Sima Shi.
